description: This Java class implements a logging operation within the Apache OFBiz MiniLang framework. It provides functionality to log messages at various levels during the execution of a mini-language script based on XML configuration.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Represents a logging operation that outputs messages at various levels during script execution, based on XML configuration input.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Log operation by parsing XML attributes and setting log level and message.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the log operation, outputting the message if the specified log level is enabled.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the log element with its current attributes.
